whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text:
I am midway through my senior project.
I will have an exhibition of my holograms and film for my senior project at the end
of this semester.
I designed this exhibition to show the variety of holograms one could make with the multiplex
equipment.
Last spring I contacted Hart Perry.
He was on my radar because several years ago he had an exhibition of his holograms at Bard.
My plan was to make a hologram of an actual crystal from filming the crystal with an electron
microscope in the Bard science department.
I needed a machine that turned film frames into a hologram.
He had such a machine which he invented with Bill Maltini and Rudy Burkhout in the 70s.
And he made a hologram of a hemoglobin molecule.
He made a hologram of a hemoglobin molecule with an electron microscope in the biology
department of Columbia University.
We had something in common.
His hologram machine had broken down in a Manhattan hologram company that he had leased
it to.
So he moved it to a building on his estate where with my help he would return the machine
to its glory days of operation and it would be used for my senior project.
In the meantime he introduced me to the laboratory of his former partner in holography Rudy Burkhout.
He was a very good friend of mine.
